raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Strength Programme for Advanced Pregnant Lifter"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain and build strength during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          banded_side_walk 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow_stretch 5m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          arm_ergometer 6m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_dumbbell_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_bicep_curl 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_opener_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:

        cooldown:

  PHASE "Phase 2: Strength Progression" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_front_squat 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:

        main straight_sets:
          standing_dumbbell_press 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          single_arm_cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

          triceps_rope_pushdown 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:

    WEEK 6:
